generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of contract value), as a prime contractor, at least one similar work such as Decantation of furnace oil or Fabrication/errection/maintenance of mechanical equipment in any thermal plant of value not less than Rs.11.49 Lakhs in the last five years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) in any Thermal power stations having capacity of generating unit not less than 200MW. As a proof of this the bidder should upload a single work order and corresponding work done certificate issued by the competent authority (work done of previous year shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to price level of financial year 2026-27).

The intending bidder shall have experience in Decantation of furnace oil or Fabrication/errection/maintenance of mechanical equipment in any thermal plant. As a proof of this, bidder should upload relevant work orders.

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.22.98 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last five years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26). As a proof of this bidder shall upload the certified copy of the profit and loss account or turn over certificate duly certified by chartered Accountant. (Financial turnover of previous year shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to price level of financial year 2025-26).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Decantation of Furnace Oil from BTPN railway wagons (10 Rakes) at RTPS

itemList.description: Decantation of furnace oil from BTPN railway tank wagons including cost of all materials, labours etc., including shifting of tray / open drum / cans to collect the spilled oil with all leads complete.
Special assistance pertains to mixing of additives/other required work.

Supply of fine aggregate including stacking in standard heaps, spreading, forming and mixing the fine aggregate with spilled oil and heaping oil mixed fine aggregate and disposing to approved disposal area including cost of all labours, materials etc., complete with all leads.

Providing 3 No. of operatives for carrying out fuels office works such as daily entry of Railway Receipts, Coal bill invoices, RR surrendering, efficiency parameters, mill reject office receipts, GST invoices, RR pushing works and header connecting works in FMS at RTPS.
